title: Progress Software Telerik Report Server ObjectReader Deserialization of Untrusted Data Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Progress Software Telerik Report Server. Authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the ObjectReader class. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of user-supplied data, which can result in deserialization of untrusted data. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of SYSTEM.
